items.heading: Grapevine Daily Quote October 8
items.text: Sometimes taking somebody else’s inventory can be most beneficial. When I was doing my Fourth Step, an old-timer suggested I list the names of those against whom I held resentments, followed by two or three sentences describing what they had done to earn my displeasure. Then, after putting the list aside for a day, I was to cross off each person’s name and replace it with my own.
items.attribution: “Mirror, Mirror, On the Wall,” Renton, Washington, October 1987, Step By Step

items.heading: Cita Diaria con La Viña Octubre 8
items.text: Mientras más dispuesto estoy a aceptar cuando me equivoco, me encuentro cada vez menos en la posición de tener que admitirlo.
items.attribution: “Nunca debajo de la alfombra”. ENERO DE 1967. Del AA Grapevine
